start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:keep-media-edits-and-versions with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_me on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-me-postgres-connection\"} and writes [{\"kind\": \"command\", \"edit_id\": \"e1\", \"seq\": 1, \"command\": {\"type\": \"set\", \"path\": [\"title\"], \"value\": \"A\"}}]."
no_lists_because: It names no list: the commands, snapshots and versions of a media edit are kept in the person's own store, in whatever form that store keeps things, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:keep-media-edits-and-versions" with store, and the commands, snapshots and versions to keep.
3. The first run makes the store's own objects once and proves them on the example attempts; every attempt must be kept, repeated or refused as the intent says, or the run stops and says which.
4. Every later run keeps the new commands, snapshots and versions and reads each edit's snapshot and the commands after it back.

worked_examples.title: A title change kept once, then sent again
worked_examples.ask: Set the title of the example edit to A.

store.where: postgresql database example_me on my own computer

worked_examples.given: The look step found the commands, snapshots and versions already kept by an earlier run.
worked_examples.hands_back: kept ["e1#1"] the first time; sent again it comes back repeated and writes nothing, and found lists the commands after the snapshot with seq 1.
